summary: Phase 23 (KB5 completeness capstone) landed as PARTIAL. Before writing any code, per instructions, the completeness construction was worked through on paper and found genuinely blocked: extractModelKb5's relation is forced to be Relation.EuclGen (Relation.SymmGen acc.hasEdge), the least kb5FC-satisfying relation preserving every raw edge, and this relation does NOT keep the root's reach capped at direct successors the way Five's non-symmetrized closure does -- confirmed by a machine-checked scout lemma (extractModelKb5_root_reach_scout, FrameCompleteness.lean, zero axioms). modalApplyOneFive's root-restricted propagation rule (Phase 22's literal KB5 alias) is provably insufficient for the completeness direction, though it remains fully sound. This is NOT an impossibility -- K5/KB5 completeness via a rooted Euclidean tableau is standard in the literature; the gap is specifically reusing modalApplyOneFive's rule, which was deliberately restricted for Five's own soundness. modalTableauKb5_complete/instDecidableKb5Valid are marked [BLOCKED] in the plan, not attempted with a sorry. All other Phase 23 sub-deliverables landed sorry-free and axiom-clean: extractModelKb5 extraction infrastructure, a new general EuclGen.symm_of_symm lemma (Euclidean.lean), accurate docstring reconciliation in FrameCompleteness.lean and S5Simplification.lean (replacing the stale/optimistic forward-pointing notes), the five-s5-separation probe theorems ported into FrameSoundness.lean, and a decide-backed regression test in CslibTests/ModalFrameSeparation.lean confirming box p -> p is s5Valid but not fiveValid/kb5Valid.

blockers.phase: Phase 23: KB5 completeness, Decidable (kb5Valid phi), and final docstring reconciliation
blockers.finding: modalApplyOneFive's root-restricted box/diamond propagation (kept unmodified as modalApplyOneKb5 by Phase 22's 'factor, not clone' soundness argument) only forces propagated content at DIRECT acc.hasEdge successors of the root. extractModelKb5's relation -- forced to be Relation.EuclGen (Relation.SymmGen acc.hasEdge), the least kb5FC-satisfying relation preserving every raw edge -- relates the root to every world reachable via a raw-edge chain through a direct successor (e.g. 0 -> a -> c gives (extractModelKb5 b acc).r 0 c), not merely to direct successors. A raw chain 0 -> a -> c (a non-root minting a fresh witness c, a routine reachable shape under Route (a)'s witness-reuse mint arms) is exactly the case where T(psi)@c in b is not forced by the existing rule, yet the closure relates root to c -- breaking the truth lemma's root box-positive case.
blockers.not_an_impossibility: K5/KB5 completeness via a rooted Euclidean tableau is standard (Blackburn-de Rijke-Venema section 4.8-4.9). What is blocked is specifically reusing modalApplyOneFive's root-restricted rule for the completeness direction.
blockers.fix_requires: A genuinely new KB5-specific propagation rule (root triggers dumping to the full non-root cluster, plus -- since root becomes reflexive whenever it has a successor, Relation.symm_rightEuclidean_root_refl -- propagating root's own box content back onto world 0), with its own soundness proof (the same unrestricted propagation would be unsound for the strictly larger fiveFC class, so 'factor, not clone' does not transfer to this direction) and its own completeness argument. Comparable in scope to Phases 15-21's Five construction -- a follow-up task, not a same-dispatch fix.
